name: Virginia Vinegar Works
old_description: This rare vinegar is dark red and heavy bodied with a rich nose. It goes well with bold, mixed greens and blue cheese. Particularly good in a meat marinade or to add structure in marinara sauces and stews
about:
Virginia Vinegar Works was founded in 2008 in Shipman, Virginia. The company began with humble production of wine vinegar in porcelain crocks and has since expanded to using stainless steel tanks for fermentation and older wine barrels for ageing.

The company produces artisanal vinegars using the traditional Orleans method, a slow conversion process that retains the character of the base wine. Its lineup includes barrel-aged wine vinegars (both blended and single-varietal), seasonal fruit vinegars made with fresh local fruit, and robust malt vinegars sourced from nearby craft breweries. Production occurs in stainless steel tanks with extended barrel ageing, though facility size and output volumes are not disclosed.

Virginia Vinegar Works serves professional chefs, restaurants, gourmet food outlets, and home cooks seeking exceptional flavor. Its products are marketed for both culinary professionals and retail consumers, with an emphasis on local ingredients from Virginia vineyards and farms.

The business was born from a desire to add exceptional flavor to the region's produce and meats. The founders chose the Orleans method specifically to preserve the original wine's richness and character, and they continue to select barrels for blending after extended ageing.
